summary: The tester previously reported 66 task-02 Playwright passes plus passing node tests/verify.js, gdsync, wbsaveall, task-01 row, and task-03 buttons suites, but the passing 66-case raw report, geometry attachments, and current screenshots were not retained. The retained browser-verification-report.json and three screenshots cover only a historical 53-case run. A later independent review discovered 66 task cases / 223 root cases but could not execute Chromium because launch ended with sandbox_host_linux.cc:41 / Operation not permitted; the team regression sandbox also failed to create a NETLINK_ROUTE socket. The ignored test-results/report.json records 223 skipped cases and is not passing evidence. No new tests were run in this implementer round under the role instruction assigning testing to Tester A3. No product defect was confirmed. The implementation and test commits 8eaa1a4 and ae0cf4e exist, but this round's report corrections remain uncommitted: git add -A exited 128 because .git/index.lock could not be created on the read-only filesystem. Current executable verification and retained artifacts remain required before merge approval.
